edit.description: a `.claude/` directory entry is claimed when every file beneath it is in reached_files

summary: a `.claude/` directory whose every file an import reaches draws no unclaimed-entry; one holding any unreached file still does
acceptance: root CLAUDE.md importing `@.claude/notes/a.md` with `.claude/notes/` holding only a.md gives no unclaimed-entry; adding an unimported b.md brings the `.claude/notes` finding back
tests: a directory whose every file an import reaches draws no unclaimed-entry finding
a directory holding an unreached file still draws an unclaimed-entry finding
notes: Residual of AN-IMPORT-REACHED-FILE-IS-CLAIMED (claim is per file entry). `every`, not `some`: a some-reached claim would hide the unreached file, since the scan names direct children only.
